title: Preparation of feeder-free iPSCs culture
author: Celeste M M. Karch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x83fryn

steps.title: Coat Tissue Culture Dish
steps.instruction: Coat an appropriately sized tissue culture dish with Matrigel and swirl the plate to distribute the coating evenly across the surface.

steps.title: Set Matrigel Coating
steps.instruction: Allow the Matrigel to set for 1 hour at room temperature or in a 37 °C humidified chamber.

steps.title: Prepare mTeSR1 Feeder-Free Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare the medium by aseptically mixing the supplement and basal medium.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 mL of thawed 5x supplement to 400 mL Basal Medium.
Mix thoroughly and warm to room temperature.

steps.title: Thaw iPSCs
steps.instruction: Thaw iPSCs (1-2 x 10^6 cells/mL) in a 37 °C water bath.

steps.title: Wash and Centrifuge iPSCs
steps.instruction: Wash the thawed cells and pellet them via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of thawed iPSC to 9 mL of DMEM/F12 in a 15mL conical tube without mixing.
Centrifuge the iPSCs at 750 rpm for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend iPSCs
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in specialized medium, ensuring cell clumps remain intact.

substeps.instruction: Carefully aspirate the medium from the iPSC pellet.
Add 2 mL of mTeSR1 supplemented with Rock inhibitor (10 μM final).

steps.title: Plate iPSCs
steps.instruction: Seed the cells onto the prepared Matrigel dish and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate Matrigel from the tissue culture dish.
Place the plate in a 37 °C, 5% CO2 and 95% humidified chamber, using a 'T' motion to ensure even cell distribution.

steps.title: Maintain iPSC Culture
steps.instruction: Perform daily medium changes and adjust volume based on confluency.

substeps.instruction: Change medium with 2 mL of fresh mTeSR1 medium daily.
Increase mTeSR1 volume to 3 mL per well as iPSCs become more confluent.
